name: LibreNMS
description: The daily updater pulls or checks out newer LibreNMS code and, in its post-pull path, runs Composer installation for dependencies. The default configuration leaves daily updates enabled, so the source supports an automatic primary code-update path; no signature verification is shown.
limitations: The checked-in path does not establish signed-commit verification or release provenance.
Snapshot is a newly retrieved default branch, not the historical study revision.
